top: In 1964, two scientists couldn't get rid of a strange hiss in their giant antenna. At one point they even blamed pigeon poop.
comment: They cleaned it all out, and the noise stayed. It was the leftover glow of the Big Bang. Arno Penzias and Robert Wilson won the 1978 Nobel Prize for it.
topic_it: Penzias e Wilson (Bell Labs, antenna di Holmdel): il rumore di fondo che credevano dovuto ai piccioni era la radiazione cosmica di fondo; Nobel 1978
photo_it: Penzias e Wilson davanti all'antenna (Nokia Bell Labs) + l'antenna Holmdel Horn (IEEE Spectrum)
title: They thought it was bird droppings, but it was the Big Bang #spacefacts #astronomy #science
description:
Arno Penzias and Robert Wilson blamed pigeons for the hiss in their antenna, but it was the cosmic microwave background, and it won them the 1978 Nobel Prize.
